hintroom.level6.embers: Dark room: red guides the bridge, then each hero lights their own brazier.
hintroom.level6.gauntlet: Four bridges in a row: each hero carries the lantern in turn. Keep the pace!
hintroom.level6.hearth: The second wraith guards the hearth. Beat it, then pull all four levers together.
hintroom.level6.islets: Dark room: the bearer changes at each bridge. Clear the bank before crossing.
hintroom.level6.keys: Everyone fetches their key, then blue guides over the long bridge. Dark room!
hintroom.level6.quay: The lantern bearer (blue hero) lights the bridge: stay inside the glow!
hintroom.level6.terrace: Long winding bridge. On the island: red holds the beacon, everyone pulls a lever.
hintroom.level6.throne: The Void Lord awaits. Take cover behind the pillars and keep dodging!
hintroom.level6.wraithhall: A flying wraith guards this hall. Then hold four plates at once.
level.level6.intro.1: Beneath Vaelorn, the earth opens onto an abyss of dead stars, dotted with stone islets.
level.level6.intro.2: The ancient shadow sleeps at the very bottom. Here, only a lantern can trace a path.
level.level6.intro.3: One bearer lights the bridge, the others stay in its glow. Take turns, my friends!
level.level6.intro.4: Glimmers? So small... I will snuff them out one by one, and the void will swallow you.
level.level6.intro.5: Then we move together, step by step in the light. Whose turn is it with the lantern?
level.level6.name: The Abyss of the Void
level.level6.outro.1: The Void Lord crumbles into stardust. The abyss fills with a soft light.
level.level6.outro.2: It is over... The ancient shadow is at peace. Each of you lit the road for the others.
level.level6.outro.3: The Crystal shines brighter than ever. Vaelorn will fear neither shadow nor night!
level.level6.outro.4: Shall we go home? This time I carry the lantern... and dessert.
objective.level6.hunt: Land 4 killing blows at the hearth
objective.level6.seal: Open your door with your key
room.level6.embers.name: The Ember Sanctuary
room.level6.gauntlet.name: The Great Bridge of Souls
room.level6.hearth.name: The Wraith's Hearth
room.level6.islets.name: The Resting Islets
room.level6.keys.name: The Eclipse Gallery
room.level6.quay.name: The Starlit Quay
room.level6.terrace.name: The Beacon Terrace
room.level6.throne.name: The Void Throne
room.level6.wraithhall.name: The Wraith's Hall
sign.level6.embers.braziers: Four colored braziers: each hero lights their own to open the door.
sign.level6.embers.dark: Dark room: a lit brazier refills your torch (Action).
sign.level6.embers.refuel: A lit brazier: refill your torch before lighting your own!
sign.level6.embers.winding: The red hero carries the lantern on the winding bridge. Stay in the glow.
sign.level6.gauntlet.last: Last bridge: the yellow hero lights the way to the final shore.
sign.level6.gauntlet.relay: Four bridges, four bearers: blue, red, green then yellow guide in turn.
sign.level6.gauntlet.rest: A resting islet, but an ambush. Clear it before the next bridge.
sign.level6.gauntlet.river: The shore of the Void. Defeat its guardians to reach the exit.
sign.level6.hearth.door: The hearth door: levers pulled, wraith defeated, hunt objective done.
sign.level6.hearth.hunt: The green hero must land 4 killing blows. Give them a chance!
sign.level6.hearth.levers: Four levers in the corners, one per hero: pull them all within the 12 s window.
sign.level6.hearth.wraith: The second wraith guards the hearth with a horde of minions. Stay together!
sign.level6.islets.bank: Last bank: an ambush springs when you move away from the bridge.
sign.level6.islets.dark: Dark room: refill your torch at the lit braziers (Action).
sign.level6.islets.rest: A resting islet between two bridges. Red guides the first, green the second.
sign.level6.islets.second: The second bridge bends. Bearer, take it slowly!
sign.level6.keys.bridge: The blue hero carries the lantern over the long bridge. Clear the hall first.
sign.level6.keys.dark: Dark room: your torch burns down. Refill it at the lit braziers.
sign.level6.keys.doors: Everyone opens THEIR door with THEIR key. All four open the exit gallery.
sign.level6.keys.keys: Everyone fetches their key from their corner chamber. Regroup at the bridge.
sign.level6.quay.bridge: Outside the light, the bridge does not exist. Follow the bearer, tile by tile.
sign.level6.quay.lantern: The lantern bearer lights the bridge. Here it is the blue hero.
sign.level6.quay.shore: The far shore. Move on: something lurks at the end of the quay.
sign.level6.terrace.beacon: The beacon: the red hero must stand here 8 s (cumulative) to open the door.
sign.level6.terrace.island: Beacon island. An ambush springs as you advance.
sign.level6.terrace.levers: Each lever belongs to one hero. Pull them all within the 12 s window.
sign.level6.terrace.winding: Long winding bridge: the yellow hero carries the lantern. Clear this bank first.
sign.level6.throne.cover: Pillars stop projectiles. The sealed exit opens once he falls.
sign.level6.throne.warning: The Void Lord: rings, spirals, danger zones. Keep moving!
sign.level6.wraithhall.door: The door opens once all four plates are held. The wraith must be defeated.
sign.level6.wraithhall.plates: Four plates in the corners: each hero holds theirs, all at once.
sign.level6.wraithhall.wraith: A flying wraith: it vanishes, reappears and fires dark bolts. Take cover!
